'''Obsidian Statue''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''': Discard Obsidian Statue to cancel all [[Stamina]] or [[Sanity]] loss being dealt to you from one source.

'''Price''': $4
